metadata.description: Variable scoping, assignment operators, mathematical evaluations, and dynamic color transformations

declaration_rule.description: Variables are declared using the '>' sigil and '=' assignment operator. NEVER use colon notation.

bad.reason: CSS colon notation or missing > sigil

scoping_hierarchy.level: Component parameter arguments shadow outer scope variables

nested_token_objects.description: Tokens grouped hierarchically using object literals, accessed via dot notation.

font_stack_rule.description: Font fallback chains in variables MUST ALWAYS be a single string literal. Unquoted commas cause parse errors.

function.name: alpha
function.description: Sets or scales alpha transparency (0.0 to 1.0)

function.name: mix
function.description: Linearly blends two colors by weight (0.0 to 1.0)
